# Purcellville Family Restaurant
> Pull Up a Chair. There's Always Something Good on the Table.

- Location: 110 W Main St, Purcellville, VA 20132
- Phone: (540) 338-3000
- Website: https://purcellvillefamilyrestaurant.com
- Cuisine: American Comfort Food, Homestyle Cooking, Diner Breakfast & Lunch Platters
- Established: 1983 on West Main Street

## Operating Hours
- Monday – Thursday: 6:00 AM – 8:00 PM
- Friday: 6:00 AM – 8:30 PM (Dinner & Chef Specials)
- Saturday: 6:30 AM – 8:30 PM (All-Day Breakfast)
- Sunday: 7:00 AM – 3:00 PM (Sunday Family Brunch)

## Signature Dishes
- Slow-Sauced Country Ribs & Fries: Tender pork ribs smothered in barbecue glaze with golden skin-on fries and coleslaw ($16.95).
- Homestyle Spaghetti with Meat Sauce: Hearty beef marinara on spaghetti with garlic toast on signature turquoise plate ($14.95).
- Toasted Club & Broccoli Cheddar Soup: Thick grilled sourdough ham melt with chips and steaming soup ($12.95).
- Western Loudoun Breakfast Burrito: Scrambled eggs, sausage, peppers, fresh berries, and dual house salsas ($11.95).
- Buttermilk Pancake Stack: Griddled golden pancakes with hardwood bacon and maple syrup ($10.50).
- Bottomless Fresh Diner Coffee: Served hot in heavy ceramic diner mugs ($2.95).
